prompts.prompt: Create an RPG Maker MV face sheet for Uncle James, based on the supplied face sheet as STYLE REFERENCE only. Match its restrained hand-painted storybook anime rendering, fine textured linework, muted palette and proportions. James is a middle-aged man around 40-45, visibly distinct from Dad: short neatly side-parted dark brown hair, slightly broader face, clean shaven, black funeral suit white shirt and dark tie. No bald crown, no white hair, no elderly wrinkles. Quiet kind expression at a funeral. Exactly 8 bust portraits of SAME man in an exact 4 columns by 2 rows equally sized grid. Reading order: neutral, gently concerned, downcast, listening, speaking softly, eyes closed, grieving quietly, slight reassuring expression. Identical head scale and positioning per cell, full head and shoulders within each cell. Transparent background, no borders, no text, no decorative items, no overlap. Target 576x288, each cell 144x144; if higher resolution use exact 2:1 canvas with equal square cells.

Create RPG Maker MV face sheet for Grace's aunt at Grandma's funeral. Use supplied Mom face sheet solely to match hand-painted storybook anime style, quiet muted earth palette, fine textured linework and bust proportions. A distinct woman aged about 40-45, chestnut brown chin-length bob tucked behind one ear, softly rounded face, restrained mourning black blouse with black cardigan, no jewelry, no grey hair, no elderly wrinkles. Exactly 8 portraits of SAME aunt in equally spaced 4 columns by 2 rows grid. Row-major expressions: neutral, gentle concern, looking down, listening, speaking softly, eyes closed, quiet grief, gently reassuring. Uniform centered head scale, shoulder and entire head fully contained within each square cell. No props, no writing, no gridlines, no cell overlap. Actual transparent background. 2:1 canvas aspect ratio, intended final sheet 576x288 with 144x144 cells.

Heads same size and each fully within its cell, shoulders visible, no overlap. Transparent background, no borders, no words. Intended MV output 576x288 and 144px square cells.
